evals.prompt: The current directory is a small Linux-like tree (Makefile with VERSION/PATCHLEVEL, include/linux/, kernel/, init/, Documentation/). There is a broken tutorial at evals/files/broken-tutorial.md (copied next to you as broken-tutorial.md). Fix it in place so it becomes a valid kernel tutorial for the fake_key mechanism in this tree: elixir links with verified #L against files on disk, {#slug} on every heading, no numbers in headings, --- before every ## except the first, .secref targets that exist, no possessive 's, one elixir version prefix (v6.16). Write the result to outputs/fake_key.md.
evals.expected_output: A Markdown tutorial at outputs/fake_key.md that passes scripts/check-tutorial --tree <mini-kernel>

Every elixir link has #L and that line contains the linked symbol
All elixir links use the same version prefix

evals.expected_output: A short Markdown tutorial at outputs/fake_key.md grounded in the fixture sources and passing the checker
expectations: Wrote outputs/fake_key.md rather than only a chat answer
check-tutorial reports 0 errors against the mini-kernel tree
Mentions fake_key_enable, fake_key_disable, fake_key_init, and early_boot_setup
Grounds the init-ordering invariant in early_boot_setup (a Concretely: call site)
